title: Περὶ κράσεως καὶ δυνάμεως τῶν ἁπλῶν φαρμάκων — De simplicium medicamentorum temperamentis ac facultatibus (Simple Drugs); RU: Гален, «О смешении и силе простых лекарств»
author: Galen of Pergamon
size: 11 books, Kühn XI 379–892 and XII 1–377 (c. 890 pp. with Latin); est. 130–150k Greek words
edition: Only Kühn 1826 (Greek and Latin, public domain). Fichtner: CMG edition of Book IX in preparation (Martelli). Petit 2010: editio princeps of I.1–3.
ru_evidence: Not in the ru.wikipedia Galen translation list (1971; Balalykin I–V, 2014–18; journal pieces). The contents of vols II–V were not checked in detail.
en_evidence: Fichtner Galen bibliography (BBAW 2023/12, no. 78) lists only Garofalo's 1985 sample and Petit's annotated French of I.1–3. No English.
other_translations: French: Petit 2010 (I.1–3 only). German: Haars 2018 translates Oribasius' Collections XV, an excerpt of this work's drug catalogue.
value: Galen's foundational theory of drug action (qualities and degrees) and antiquity's fullest critical pharmacopoeia. Book X (animal substances) includes his polemic against using human body parts as drugs. Core source for history of pharmacy, Arabic and Latin reception, material culture.
ai_feasibility: theory books high; catalogue books medium-low. Zainaldin et al. 2026: LLM failures track rare pharmacological terms (r = −.97). Requires term-frequency flagging and multi-model review.
pilot_unit: Book X (animal substances, incl. the polemic on human parts), est. 12–15k words. Avoids Book IX, now under CMG edition.
